evidence: The compositions of the deposited films were determined using backscattering spectrometry. The film thicknesses as measured using optical transmission analysis vary between 70 and 100 nm... Capacitances and loss factors were measured at a frequency of 100 kHz using an HP 4192A impedance analyzer, and the I- V curves with an HP 4142B modular d.c. source at a ramp rate of 1-3 V s -1. The elemental composition of the films was analyzed using backscattering spectrometry.
